name: calibrate_forecast
description: Calibrated superforecast anchored to Tetlock's GJP methodology. Runs Fermi decomposition on growth and margin estimates, applies outside/inside view adjustments, distributes probabilities across four Schwartz scenarios, and produces a probability-weighted intrinsic value.

growth_estimate.description: Revenue growth estimate 0.0–1.0. If omitted runs Fermi decomposition.

margin_estimate.description: Profit margin estimate 0.0–1.0. If omitted runs Fermi.

reference_count.description: N cases for outside-view calibration. Default 500.
